/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: TO CALL 'LOV_SD_PORTS' FORM
PROGRAMMER : Salman AL-matek
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1-4-1423
*/
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CONTRIES_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 
IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 99 THEN
 :FROM_PORT := NULL;
 :FROM_PORT_NAME := NULL;

 --======================================================================================
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار منافذ الدخول ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_SD_PORTS.FMX',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 :FROM_PORT:= :GLOBAL.PORT_CD ;
 :FROM_PORT_NAME := :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME ;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END IF;
--=======================================================================================
ELSE
 :FROM_PORT :=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
 SELECT PORT_NAME
 INTO :FROM_PORT_NAME
 FROM SD_PORTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FROM_PORT',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL ;
END ;
NEXT_ITEM;

PROCEDURE CHECK_VALUE IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
V_COUNT NUMBER(5):=1;
 BEGIN 
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata');

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(SDP.PORT_CD) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM
SD_PORTS SDP
,VHCL_CARDS VCRD
WHERE
VCRD.PORT_CD = SDP.PORT_CD AND
(:TO_date IS NULL OR VCRD.VHCL_CARD_DT <= :TO_date) AND
(:from_date IS NULL OR VCRD.VHCL_CARD_DT >= :from_date) ;

TRANSITS TRS

(TDC.PORT_CD_OUT = SDP.PORT_CD) AND

(:FROM_PORT IS NULL OR TDC.PORT_CD_OUT = :FROM_PORT) AND
(:TO_DATE IS NULL OR TRS.TRNST_DT <= :TO_DATE) AND
(:FROM_DATE IS NULL OR TRS.TRNST_DT >= :FROM_DATE) AND
(:trnst_type IS NULL OR TRS.TRNST_TYPE = :trnst_type) ;*/
